page.overview:
Who is Bjorn?

Bjorn is a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates. He serves as a minor ally during the Egghead Arc.

Like all giants, Bjorn is a man of exceptional size. He has pink, puffy hair, and a rounded jaw, with a flat end. He wears a helmet with horns, a dark shirt, and pants held up by suspenders.

From his behavior, it can be assumed that Bjorn is a brave individual, given that he fearlessly stood against an attempted attack on the Great Eirik by the elder, Marcus Mars.

As a giant, Bjorn possesses superhuman strength and resistance. Alongside his crewmates, he was capable of holding back an energy beam fired by Mars.
